In recent membership surveys, AMBA has found that members cite industry knowledge as one of the top benefits of AMBA membership, and technical expertise as an area where they’d like to learn more – at the same time, our partners indicated that they would like more opportunities to connect with AMBA members and share the industry knowledge in which they specialize. With this blog, the AMBA team hopes to create a channel through which knowledge can flow and connections can be formed. Who benefits from this content? AMBA’s intention with the launch of an Industry Expert Insights Blog on the AMBA website is to give each Premier Partner more exposure to members and the industry, along with a platform on which to share their technical and/or industry-specific knowledge and expertise with interested AMBA members. In turn, these blogs will provide members with an opportunity to gain technical knowledge about specific services and opportunities offered by each partner, as well as a contact to reach out to if they have a need in that area. How will this content be shared? Expert Insight blog posts will be shared on the AMBA website and on AMBA’s social media channels. All AMBA Premier Partners have the opportunity to post at least one time during each calendar year. (https://amba.org/membership/amba-mission-and-vision/) 【turn411861search4】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last week; To learn more about membership and getting involved with the AMBA, contact the AMBA offices at 317.436.3102 or email [email protected]. # Who is an AMBA Member? #### Who is an AMBA Member? AMBA member companies are domestic mold manufacturers who build the majority of their molds in the U.S., either for customers in a variety of industries or for internal operations.  Located across the country, AMBA members range in employee size from one individual to 200+.  If you are a U.S. mold manufacturer interested in... * Becoming more profitable, * Having a voice on Capitol Hill,  * Learning from functional area peers, * Touring peer facilities, * Implementing new technologies, * Staying abreast of current economic and industry trends, * Workforce growth and development and/or * Accessing cost-reduction opportunities then YOU are ready to benefit from AMBA membership! Learn More and Join Today #### AMBA Partners: Suppliers to the AMBA Community AMBA partners are industry suppliers that provide U.S. mold builders with specific goods and services. AMBA partners traditionally do not make molds; rather, they provide ancillary goods and services that help U.S. mold manufacturers operate successfully.  AMBA partners pay annual membership fees for access to the AMBA community, advertising opportunities and additional publicity in the annual AMBA Sourcebook publication. Examples of AMBA partner company types include, but are not exclusive to: * 3D Printing * Advising and Consulting * CAD/CAM Services * Hot Runner Systems * Insurance * Marketing Services * Magnetic Systems * Mold and Die Components * MRO Supplies * Shipping Services * And More! View Current AMBA Partners #### Get Involved The AMBA is always seeking new and passionate U.S. mold builders for its initiatives in advocacy, benchmarking, industry development and more. To learn more about membership and getting involved with the AMBA, contact the AMBA offices at 317.436.3102 or email [email protected]. # About us

We’re here for you!

## Founded in 1976 by 18 industry leaders who sought to create an organization where manufacturers and distributors of construction/industrial products could interface.

The 18 industry leaders that founded STAFDA contracted with industry veteran Morrie Halvorsen to serve as the first executive director. Upon his retirement in December 1999, Georgia Foley assumed C.E.O. responsibilities on January 1st, 2000.

In the past 47 years, STAFDA has grown from the initial 18 founding members to 2,200+ member companies comprised of distributors, associate/manufacturers, publishing affiliates, and manufacturer rep/agents.

## Dues & Benefits

Annual membership dues have remained constant at $350 since 1977 while services and programs have continued to expand. STAFDA members enjoy a “buffet” of over 70 different benefits where they can pick and choose what suits their business.

## Annual Convention & Trade Show

STAFDA holds an Annual Convention & Trade Show each fall for members to convene and take part in educational programs, seminars, and an exciting trade show that is always well attended by leading manufacturing, distribution, and rep agencies within the industry.
